prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 30s goddess, pregnant glamour physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure carrying a full-term pregnancy, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projecting forward well past her own chest, the navel pushed slightly outward, and below the belly her hips flare wide and curvaceous; her waistline has fully given way to the pregnancy's round, taut curve, a soft rounded middle, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, long curly chocolate brown hair — full body weathered bronze crusted with blue-green verdigris fused directly to her own form wrapping her whole body from the collarbones to the ankles, both legs carved all the way down to the ankles — this is solid bronze curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted bronze sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, every section standing proud of the next. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING dark bronze with blue-green verdigris patina across the full torso and both legs down to the ankles, VIVID pale turquoise verdigris crusting in every recess, with fine gold inlay lines tracing every joint between the sections, weathered satin patina, completely opaque, with a deep three-dimensional carved surface. Pose: three-quarter angle, her torso turned about forty-five degrees from the camera and her face looking back toward the lens over her shoulder, one hand resting on her lower back and the other relaxed at her side, her belly curving out in clear contour, her legs fully in view — most extreme pregnant glamour silhouette ever displayed.
Cracks: the verdigris bronze body shows weathering in only two places: one bold, clearly visible crack running across her left thigh, and one chipped-off piece at her right upper arm, where the broken edge reveals the raw reddish-orange cast metal with a rough surface inside. Everywhere else, including her bust and her round pregnant belly, the verdigris bronze is smooth, polished and whole, and her face, ears and neck are living skin.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals in black leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts, with her legs and ankles staying solid carved verdigris bronze right down to the shoes.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, made of the same verdigris bronze with a high polish.
Jewelry: a delicate silver body chain draped across her collarbones and down her torso, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face, ears and entire neck are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: heavy pink-red eyeshadow smudged wide beneath both eyes like crying, faint tear-track blush running down the cheeks, large eyes with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy dark-cherry lips. Her neck, from under the jaw down to the base of the neck, is bare real skin with visible pores and a soft natural sheen; the carved body starts exactly at the base of the neck, and her shoulders, chest, round pregnant belly with its navel, arms, hands, wrists, legs and ankles are all carved verdigris bronze.

Background: a mirrored cube room with mirrors on all four walls, the ceiling and a glossy black floor, thin hot-pink neon LED strips running along every corner so the pink lines multiply into an endless glowing lattice in all directions, her figure repeated in the lattice from every side, the whole floor clearly visible and in focus, lit by the pink neon and soft light with gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — carved material everywhere from the collarbones to the ankles. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the shoes to the top of her head completely visible, so the extreme heel height reads at a glance. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, the reflections being part of that same photograph. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
